---
# Theme Metadata
theme-id: "mewSpinClean"
theme-name: "mewSpinClean"
theme-description: "mewSpin leve: só o Mew, fundos em cor sólida"

# Color Palette
color-primary: "#FF1493"
color-secondary: "#FF69B4"
color-accent: "#FF69B4"
color-success: "#10b981"
color-warning: "#f59e0b"
color-error: "#ef4444"
color-background: "#1C1217"
color-surface: "#1F151A"
color-text: "var(--text-normal)"
color-text-muted: "var(--text-muted)"

# Progress Bar
bar-sprite: "data:image/gif;base64,"
bar-sprite-width: 67
bar-sprite-height: 64
bar-sprite-click-animation: "spin"
bar-fill-gradient: "linear-gradient(90deg, #FF1493, #FF69B4)"
bar-track-bg: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
bar-height: "14px"
bar-border-radius: "6px"

# Toggle
toggle-sprite: "data:image/gif;base64,"
toggle-sprite-width: 64
toggle-sprite-height: 63
toggle-sprite-click-animation: "spin"
toggle-idle-bg: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
toggle-hover-bg: "rgba(255,20,147,0.22)"
toggle-active-bg: "#FF1493"
label-active: "Active"
label-inactive: "Inactive"

# Buttons
button-idle-bg: "#1F151A"
button-hover-bg: "#2E1B26"
button-active-bg: "#3A1A2C"
button-text-color: "#FF1493"
button-sprite-click-animation: "spin"

# Inputs & Select
input-bg: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"
input-bg-size: "cover"
input-bg-repeat: "no-repeat"
input-bg-position: "center"
input-focus-bg-size: "cover"
input-focus-bg-repeat: "no-repeat"
input-focus-bg-position: "top"
input-transition-direction: "top"
input-border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
input-border-focus: "1px solid #7c3aed"
input-border-radius: "6px"
select-bg: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"
select-bg-size: "cover"
select-bg-repeat: "no-repeat"
select-bg-position: "center"
select-open-bg-size: "cover"
select-open-bg-repeat: "no-repeat"
select-open-bg-position: "top"
select-transition-direction: "top"

# Cards
card-bg-color: "#1F151A"
card-border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"
card-border-radius: "12px"
card-shadow: "0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)"
card-padding: "16px"

# Effects & Transitions
glow-enabled: true
glow-intensity: "15px"
transition-duration: "0.3s"
border-radius-small: "6px"
border-radius-medium: "12px"
border-radius-large: "16px"

---

# mewSpinClean

mewSpin leve: só o Mew (sprite das barras e dos toggles); fundos em cor sólida, sem imagens nem GIFs.
